summary: Add a stable answer basis to every project-question result and show an English browser badge that distinguishes local, fresh-model, cached-model, retrieval-only and no-evidence paths.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient and trustworthy questions across RFI, Submittal, Email and other project evidence
The API previously omitted answer_basis on model, Mock-retrieval and empty-evidence paths
The browser previously gave users no direct indication of whether a result used the model or only local project data
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across project question flows.
known_limitations: The badge reports the execution and evidence route, not independent validation of the answer's engineering correctness.
MODEL_PROJECT_EVIDENCE identifies a model-produced response; cached=true means this request reused a settled response and made no new model call.
The change does not predict the route before submission and does not alter model selection, retrieval or budget policy.
